note: This is the media All-Star team, voted by the journalists covering the tournament — the best six of the championship rather than any one team's starting line. Three of the six come from Switzerland, who lost the final at home, and two from Finland, who won it.

xi.name: Josi
xi.full: Roman Josi — Switzerland, defence, tournament MVP

xi.name: Celebrini
xi.full: Macklin Celebrini — Canada, forward, best forward

teams.benchNote: The directorate awards are chosen separately from the All-Star vote, which is why Henrik Haukeland is the best goaltender while Leonardo Genoni is the All-Star one.
